description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling 'DeleteAttributes' commands within the Ditto service, specifically for deleting attributes from a 'Thing' object. It manages the extraction of attributes, performs deletion, and constructs appropriate result objects and event notifications.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for processing DeleteAttributes commands, deleting specified attributes from a Thing, and generating corresponding results and events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes delete attributes operation on a given Thing, returning a result indicating success or error.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the Attributes object from the Thing, if present.

methods.name: getDeleteAttributesResult
methods.description: Constructs a successful deletion result with an AttributesDeleted event.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous state for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional indicating no specific next entity tag after deletion.
